archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

rules: Headlines (>32px) MUST use tracking-tighter and leading-none.
Overlines / Labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, tracking-[0.2em].
Do not default to 'Bold'. Use 'Light' (font-light) for elegance or 'Black' (font-black) for impact.
Maximum H1 size is text-5xl sm:text-6xl. Do not use text-7xl+.
typography.installation: Import 'Outfit' and 'Satoshi' via Google Fonts or Fontshare.

rules: Never use pure #000000. Use the tinted Midnight Blue (#07090F) for backgrounds.
Use #FFB800 (Amber/Gold) exclusively for primary CTAs and high-conversion elements like 'Buy Course' or 'Enroll'.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Replace default p-4 with p-8 or p-12. Massive py-24 or py-32 for section gaps.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8). Elements should span asymmetrically (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layouts_and_spacing.mobile_first: Always start with grid-cols-1. Images must have max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content. Center-align only specific Hero headings if it improves visual rhythm.

surface_strategies.header: Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07090F]/60 with a 1px delicate bottom inner stroke border-white/10.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#10141E) with 1px subtle border border-white/5. On hover, apply slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
surface_strategies.pricing_cards: Use 'The Tracing Beam' (Linear glow/Aceternity look) for the most expensive/recommended course tier.

rules: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use shadcn dropdowns, dialogs, etc.
Forms: Never use native <input>. Use Shadcn Input, Form.
Marquee Strategy: For 'Trusted By' or 'Technologies' (e.g. Meta Ads, Google Ads), use a slow, smooth drifting marquee with low contrast.

motion.hover_states: Hover states must explicitly set text color (hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties, NEVER 'transition: all'. Example: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.

student_learning.description: Student focused on studies, representing the end-user of the platform. Use in 'About' or 'Student Dashboard' sections.

digital_marketing_desk.description: Premium desk setup with digital marketing analytics on screen. Use for course thumbnails or Hero background overlay.

cyber_neon_dashboard.description: High-tech dashboard. Ideal for the 'Admin Panel' showcase or 'Advanced Marketing Strategies' course.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-conversion Turkish e-learning platform.
Apply Archetype 5 (LUXURY) style - Midnight Blue backgrounds with High-Contrast Amber CTAs.
Build the front-end pages: Landing, About (Hakkımda), Courses (Kurslar), Course Detail, Cart, Checkout, Auth, Student Dashboard, Course Player.
Course Player must have a curriculum sidebar, video embed area, and downloadable PDF links.
Implement Shadcn UI extensively. For the landing page hero, create a striking, asymmetric Bento Grid layout.
Do NOT make a generic, centered AI-slop design. Push the boundaries with overlapping elements and generous padding.
All copy MUST be in Turkish.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Only use the provided image URLs.
